name: @generate-web-ai/site-builder
description: Build-time engine: renders an arbitrary SiteConfig (JSON, written by apps/api's publishing pipeline) through the real @generate-web-ai/renderer + @generate-web-ai/blocks + Tailwind pipeline — the same visual architecture apps/clients/* use, parameterized by data instead of hand-authored per client. Not a client site itself; not copied like apps/site-template.
